correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the integral tight-edge spanning criterion, classifies all cactus block gradients, computes exact even/odd cycle covariance via exchangeability and zero-sum constraints, obtains Cov(Y)=CP, and uses the incidence pseudoinverse to prove Cov(U)=L_c^+. The effective resistance, determinant and edge recovery then follow by series/parallel laws, the weighted Matrix--Tree Theorem and a strictly positive weighted Laplacian. Ten fully enumerated finite cases independently check each covariance entry, squared difference, facet count and determinant without replacing the infinite proof.

value.rationale: For a natural infinite family of finite metric Banach spaces, a full random-facet second moment reduces to one sparse weighted Green kernel, with nontrivial parity correction. It yields exact effective resistance statistics, a multiplicative determinant invariant and reconstruction of every labeled cactus edge, rather than a routine restatement of previously known facet totals.
